evidence: Adds script evaluation trace API functions and types to the libbitcoinkernel C API (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp`) and its C++ wrapper (`src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h`).
rationale: Adds an optional script evaluation tracer to the libbitcoinkernel API for downstream tooling. The PR enables external consumers to inspect intermediate execution state to build script debuggers and analyzers, and aids interpreter testing. While a clear addition to API capabilities, this is an optional build-time debugging and analysis tool rather than core library functionality for block validation or chainstate management.
